clue.text: Fired? Not punished at all

definitions.meaning: a gun that is fired has been discharged, set off with a bang
excused, allowed to go free without penalty

explanation.surface: Someone sacked asks whether they have escaped all punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A firework or gun is discharged when set going, and an offender excused punishment is likewise released: two senses of one phrasal verb.

clue.text: Pass around old room

indicators.note: around says the first piece sits round the second

parts.note: a pass in fencing is a thrust, a lunge

explanation.surface: Someone moves round an antique chamber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts LUNGE round O.
explanation.definitionFit: A sitting room in a house or a waiting area in an airport is a kind of room.

clue.text: Where to find epitaph in Arizona

definitions.meaning: words commemorating the dead are carved on a grave marker
a Wild West town in Arizona, famous for the O.K. Corral gunfight

explanation.surface: A question of where in Arizona to find a grave inscription.
explanation.definitionFit: A grave marker bears the inscription, and the Arizona silver-mining town of the same name is famous from Westerns.

clue.text: Referee provided rise for a player

indicators.note: in a down clue rise means the pieces are read upwards, so they are written backwards

parts.note: if means provided that

explanation.surface: A referee allows a pay rise for one of the team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rise' turns REF + IF into FI + FER; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A musician who plays the fife, a small flute, is a kind of player.

clue.text: Oppressive cops tied in knots

indicators.note: something in knots is twisted and tangled, so the letters of the words before are jumbled

explanation.surface: Heavy-handed policemen have been bound up in knots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tied' looks like the scene's action, but it is fodder: COPS + TIED are rearranged, signalled by 'in knots'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant's rule is cruel and harsh, so oppressive government is tyrannical.

clue.text: Turn out to be standing on one's head

definitions.meaning: to turn out is to finish in a particular way
upside down, with the bottom at the top

explanation.surface: Someone discovers they are doing a headstand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' is a link joining the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: To finish in a certain state is one sense, and literally the rear end raised aloft is the other.

clue.text: Soldier escorting monarch in armed vessel

indicators.note: escorting means going alongside, so one piece is set beside the other

parts.note: a private is a soldier of the lowest rank
ER is the royal cipher, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A soldier guards a queen aboard a warship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A privately owned ship licensed to attack enemy shipping was a warship of sorts.

clue.text: Label attached to American river

parts.note: a tag is a label
US stands for American, as in the United States

explanation.surface: A label is fixed on an American waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: The TAGUS is the longest river of Iberia, flowing through Lisbon.
explanation.definitionFit: The waterway crossing Spain and Portugal to Lisbon is a river.

clue.text: To make a stylish impression, edit out hyphen

definitions.meaning: to look dashing and impressive
literally, to delete a short line of punctuation

explanation.surface: A copy editor removes a hyphen to show off.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to look dashing, while literally it means deleting a punctuation stroke.

clue.text: Roughly plan hold to be used in fight

indicators.note: used in means placed inside, so one piece is put within the other

parts.note: a bout is a fight or contest
a lock is a wrestling hold

explanation.surface: A wrestler sketches a hold to deploy in a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roughly plan' reads like a fighter's tactics but is the definition; 'used in' signals the container, and 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sketch the main outline of a design without detail is to draft it.

clue.text: In France, one dealt incompetently with keeping line loud and clear

parts.note: un is French for one

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to muff something is to bungle or fumble it

explanation.surface: A French person bungles a task while staying audibly clear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' signals the container: the line sits inside the bungling word, giving the muffling word after the French article.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound with nothing damping or deadening it comes through clearly at full volume.

clue.text: Some casting, otherwise known as bullion

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark about metal casting and gold bars.
explanation.definitionFit: A cast bar of gold or silver is what bullion is held as in a bank vault.

clue.text: Abdominal 'wind an illusion, they say

indicators.note: they say signals that the words before are heard spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: wind is GAS, and an illusion or deception is a TRICK

explanation.surface: A remark that stomach wind is only imagined.
explanation.walkthrough: GAS + TRICK, spoken, sounds like the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the stomach, the organ in the belly, so a synonym of abdominal.

clue.text: Expressed admiration for novel diapers

indicators.note: novel means new or unusual, so the letters of the next word are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone enthuses about an innovative kind of nappy.
explanation.definitionFit: To laud or commend someone is to speak with approval of them.

clue.text: Patient people keep taking on male children, a result of nepotism

parts.note: Job is the Biblical model of patience, so the plural stands for patient people
a keep is a castle stronghold, a fort
he is the male pronoun
boys are male children

explanation.surface: Long-suffering folk keep adopting sons, which smacks of favouritism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking on' is a link meaning adding the further pieces. The patience of Job is proverbial.
explanation.definitionFit: Posts handed out to friends and relatives rather than earned are the typical fruit of favouritism.

clue.text: Very large tip is down to drunk, as it were

indicators.note: is down to means placed underneath, coming after in a down clue

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard
OS is short for outsize, very large
a peak is the tip or summit

explanation.surface: A big tip is left by a drunk customer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'is down to' sets OS + PEAK below SOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases flag a figurative or loose way of speaking, meaning in a manner of speaking.

clue.text: Sheriff's officer has to reward employees

parts.note: a tip is a small reward for service
a firm's employees are its staff

explanation.surface: A sheriff's man must pay his workers a gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: A TIPSTAFF is a court officer carrying a staff tipped with metal; 'has to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipstaff is a court bailiff or constable serving under a sheriff.

clue.text: Nonconformist film starring James Mason

definitions.meaning: someone who does not fit in with the rest
a 1947 Carol Reed thriller with Mason as a wounded gunman

explanation.surface: A maverick appears in a James Mason picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who doesn't fit with a group is a misfit, and the phrase is also the title of Reed's 1947 film.

clue.text: Source of trouble various microfiches CRO lost

indicators.note: various asks for the letters of the long word to be rearranged
lost says some letters, those of the short word, go missing from that rearrangement

explanation.surface: Microfiche records lost by the Criminal Records Office cause trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove C, R, O from MICROFICHES and rearrange the remaining MIFICHES. CRO was the Criminal Records Office.
explanation.definitionFit: Naughtiness or harm causes trouble, so it is the root of trouble.

clue.text: I badly affect one character, involving a radical police procedure

parts.note: to dent something is to damage or weaken it
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: involving means taking something inside, so the other pieces sit within this word

parts.note: a type is a printed character or letter

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to harming a character linked to an extremist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' signals the container: A and the radical sit inside the character. 'radical' reads as an extremist in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A line-up of suspects shown to a witness is a standard method of investigation by detectives.

clue.text: Card game — pontoon, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a trick-taking game for four players in pairs
a pontoon is a floating river crossing

explanation.surface: A card game, maybe pontoon.
explanation.walkthrough: Pontoon is also a card game, which is the false path: here it is the floating crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: A partnership trick-taking card game shares its name with a structure spanning a river, of which a pontoon is one type.

clue.text: He had wealth derived from various sources

indicators.note: various suggests different forms, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rich man whose fortune came from many places.
explanation.walkthrough: CROESUS was the fabulously rich king of ancient Lydia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lydian king's riches were proverbial, so he is the type of the rich man.

clue.text: Part of flower nothing needs to change

parts.note: O, the figure zero, stands for nothing
to vary is to change

explanation.surface: Nothing about a bloom needs altering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed-bearing base of a flower's pistil is a botanical part of it.

clue.text: Adriatic port partitioned

definitions.meaning: a Croatian city on the Dalmatian coast
divided into parts

explanation.surface: An Adriatic harbour town was divided.
explanation.definitionFit: The Croatian harbour city and the past tense of divide share a spelling.

clue.text: State of invisibility experienced up Everest?

definitions.meaning: to vanish into this is to disappear without trace
at great altitude the atmosphere has little oxygen

explanation.surface: A climber's experience of vanishing at the top of the world's highest peak.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanishing into nothingness is the idiom's sense, while literally the atmosphere at altitude is rarefied.

clue.text: Inspire current member of Order to go round university

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current

indicators.note: to go round means surrounding, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: MBE is Member of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: An honoured person tours a university to motivate it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go round' puts U inside MBE.
explanation.definitionFit: To fill or saturate someone with a feeling is to imbue them, much as to inspire.

clue.text: Representation of one wise man

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a mage is a magus, a learned wise man

explanation.surface: A picture of one of the Magi.
explanation.definitionFit: A likeness or picture is a depiction of something.

clue.text: The vital factor of libel — do recast that

indicators.note: recast means formed again, so these letters are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice to rewrite the essence of a defamation case.
explanation.walkthrough: OF LIBEL + DO are rearranged, signalled by 'recast'; 'that' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood is what keeps a body alive, so figuratively it is the essential element of anything.

clue.text: Pilot used to test public opinion

definitions.meaning: to pilot a toy on a string in the wind, literally
to float an idea to see how people react

explanation.surface: An aviator is used to gauge what the public thinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used to' is a link joining the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating a trial proposal to gauge reaction is the idiom, and steering a paper toy in the wind the literal sense.

clue.text: Kind of bait used by anglers

definitions.meaning: kind means mild and tender
the maggot of the bluebottle, used as fishing bait

explanation.surface: A remark about a sort of fishing lure.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is an old anglers' word for a maggot; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Mild and tender in manner is a synonym of kind; anglers also use the word for a blowfly maggot.
